verdict.rationale: Recurly is a SaaS billing platform with machine-learning features such as churn propensity modeling, so whether customer data can be kept out of AI training is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out, a training-data policy, or any control over AI model training on customer data. The ML feature and the MCP server are unrelated to this privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
